events.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis ESCALATION - Tanker Explosions
events.summary: Iran effectively closed Strait of Hormuz since Jul 12. Aug 5 tanker explosions near Kumzar. Trump claims 'complete control' Aug 12, Iran refutes. OPEC+ pledged +206kbpd. 20M bpd disrupted. EIA raises Brent forecast to $87 avg. Biggest global energy disruption.

events.title: US-Japan Joint FX Intervention FAILING - Yen Erases Half Gains
events.summary: Historic joint US-Japan FX intervention (~$75bn Japan + $5-10bn US) failing. Yen erased half gains, USD/JPY back at ~159. BOJ pressured to hike rates (Sept/Oct). Goldman says more intervention possible. FIMA facility weaponized. Bessent warns of 1997-style crisis risk.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic - Fastest Growing Ever, Could Become Deadliest
events.summary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC. 4,053 confirmed cases, 1,850 deaths. WHO warns could become deadliest ever. PHEIC declared. Existing treatments certified for Zaire strain, not Bundibugyo. Second-deadliest Ebola outbreak in history, largest in DRC.

events.title: France Debt Snowball - €3.5T+ Debt, H1 Interest +19%
events.summary: France national debt exceeded €3.5 trillion for first time. H1 2026 interest payments €34.5bn (+19% YoY). Fiscal deficit 5.13%. Debt-to-GDP 118%. Snowball effect feared as costly debt meets sluggish growth.

events.title: China Property $148B Expiring Lease Time Bomb + $130B Developer Defaults
events.summary: Bloomberg reports $148B expiring land lease crisis scuttling deals. Developers defaulted on ~$130B debt. Office values down 40%+ from peaks. PBOC pledges 'appropriately loose' stance but no emergency cuts. Nationwide economic emergency from property crash.

events.title: UK Food Security Crisis - 'Worst in Decades' + 27M Hosepipe Bans
events.summary: Telegraph reports 'worst food security crisis in decades'. 27M people under hosepipe bans. Drought + Hormuz disrupting fertilizer/food imports via Middle East re-export hubs. Guardian warns government ignoring stockpile measure.

events.title: US Financial Crisis Risk Building - Hedge Fund Treasury Dependency at 100x Leverage
events.summary: Telegraph: US Treasury acutely dependent on short-term funding from hedge funds tapping $8.3T money market, some at 100x leverage. Private credit PIK distress growing (Fed Boston research). Fitch defaults rising. Ingredients for US financial crisis coming together.

events.title: Venezuela-Colombia Devastating Earthquakes - Humanitarian Crisis
events.summary: Devastating earthquakes hit Venezuela and Colombia. Benefit concert organized. Stark divide in response between countries. Venezuela relies on international rescuers, Colombia declines foreign crews except US. Humanitarian crisis unfolding.

us_fed.findings: Fed held at 3.50-3.75% Jul 29. Markets pricing 30% hike probability. New Fed chair hawkish on inflation. No emergency action.

latam.findings: Venezuela-Colombia earthquakes. Argentina country risk 451bps. Milei pushing central bank reform for Aug 19 vote. Argentina peso destruction continues.

eu_ecb.findings: France debt snowball €3.5T+. ECB cut 8x Jun24-Jun25, unchanged since. Morningstar sees possible ECB rate hike 2026. No emergency action.

uk.findings: Worst food security crisis in decades. 27M hosepipe bans. BOE at 3.75%, markets pricing possible hike by Nov. Middle East conflict shifting rate expectations.

japan.findings: Joint FX intervention failing. Yen back at ~159. BOJ at 1.00%. Gov supports faster rate hike (Sept/Oct). 10Y JGB at 2.87%, 30Y at 4.00%. Goldman says capacity for more intervention.

china.findings: $148B expiring lease crisis. $130B developer defaults. PBOC loose stance, no emergency cuts. Yuan steadying as exporters squeezed. Office values down 40%+.

em_asia.findings: Korean won near 1,400, sharpest swings since financial crisis. SK intervened alongside Japan. Indian rupee cushioned by RBI. DBS short USD/KRW on intervention risks.

middle_east.findings: Hormuz closed. Tanker explosions Aug 5. Trump-Iran standoff. Gaza airstrikes resume. Netanyahu rejects withdrawal. OPEC+ +206kbpd.

africa.findings: Nigeria 36.3M food insecure. Somalia 6M crisis-level hunger. Zambia debt restructured but 70% under $3/day. South Africa crime crisis during election campaign.

financial_system.findings: US Treasury hedge fund dependency at 100x leverage. Private credit PIK distress growing. Russia bankruptcies +13.7% YoY. Swiss TBTF reforms. Senegal debt restructuring risk.

commodities.findings: Brent ~$93, EIA raises forecast to $87 avg 2026. Gold above $4,400, first real-term break of 1980 record. Saudi cut Asia OSP by $11 (biggest in 2 decades). Ukraine grain export cut to 38-40M tonnes.

pandemic_health.findings: Ebola fastest-growing ever, 4,053 cases, 1,850 deaths. Bundibugyo strain complicates response. COVID growing in 43 states. Prescription drug prices fell 3.1% (steepest since 1963).
